title: SQS message
description: Body of the SQS message ingest sends for each accepted batch. It holds the batch fields, the valid readings grouped by sensor, and per-sensor counts of rejected corrupt readings. A sensor that appears in `rejectedCounts` but not in `readings` is present but corrupt, never a dropout. Units are not repeated: ingest has already checked each one against sensors.yaml.

receivedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds on ingest's clock when the batch arrived.

rejectedCounts.description: Corrupt readings dropped by ingest, keyed by sensorId. Sensors with none rejected are left out. A corrupt reading without a valid sensorId cannot be attributed, so it only counts in the `rejected` total of the HTTP response.
